summary: A single clickable row inside a panel's dropdown menu.
description: A single actionable row inside a panel-list menu (button, checkbox item, or submenu trigger). A plain modern custom element (no JSDoc) with its own shadow root; coordinates with its owning panel-list for keyboard navigation and accesskey lifecycle.

attributes.name: accesskey
attributes.description: Observed attribute; mirrored to the internal label's accessKey. Stashed and blanked while the owning panel is closed, restored on the panel's shown event (workaround for bug 1588156).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Observed attribute, getter/setter, defaults to "button". Only recognized special value is "checkbox", which sets role=menuitemcheckbox and enables the checked property.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Observed attribute, getter/setter; reflected onto the internal button.

attributes.name: badge-type
attributes.description: Observed attribute; lazily creates a <moz-badge> element after the label and sets its type, or removes it when cleared.

attributes.name: aria-haspopup
attributes.description: Observed attribute; mirrored onto the internal button as an ARIA passthrough.

attributes.name: submenu
attributes.description: Not observed (read only once at connectedCallback via the hasSubmenu getter). Identifies the id of a nested panel-list placed in the submenu slot.

attributes.name: badged
attributes.description: Pure CSS attribute-selector hook (:host([badged]) button::after draws a small dot); not read by any JS in this component. Distinct from badge-type.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Getter/setter, only meaningful when type="checkbox"; otherwise the getter always returns false and the setter is a no-op.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Hidden default slot; its assigned text content is harvested via MutationObserver into the internal label, since a real <slot> can't be used directly for the label.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Named slot for an inline link element.

slots.name: submenu
slots.description: Named slot for a nested panel-list; its assigned node is moved directly into the shadow root when hasSubmenu is true.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-inset-block-start
cssProperties.description: Position of the CSS-only badge dot.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-inset-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Position of the CSS-only badge dot.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-size
cssProperties.description: Size of the CSS-only badge dot.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-badge-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the CSS-only badge dot, set inline to var(--color-accent-primary).

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-border-radius
cssProperties.description: Border radius of the internal button.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start
cssProperties.description: Inline-start padding of the internal button.

cssProperties.name: --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start-offset
cssProperties.description: Added on top of --panel-item-button-padding-inline-start; lets a subclass/consumer nudge the icon-accommodating inline-start padding without overriding the whole value.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The internal label element showing the item's text.

usage:
<panel-list>
  <panel-item accesskey="N">New</panel-item>
  <panel-item type="checkbox" checked>Toggle Setting</panel-item>
  <panel-item badge-type="new">Save</panel-item>
  <panel-item submenu="example-sub-menu">
    Has a submenu
    <panel-list slot="submenu" id="example-sub-menu">
      <panel-item>Submenu Item One</panel-item>
    </panel-list>
  </panel-item>
</panel-list>
